```python
import sys
import logging
from dd4hep import compileAClick, enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo, DD4hepSimulation, setPrintLevel, setOption, Geant4, importConstants, printDetectors, import_geometry, setDumpDetailedParticleInfo, show_help, CommandLine, run, load, print_, setupTrackingField, Gun, tracker, UI, setupUI, setupPhysics, PhysicsList, execute

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger("dd4hep_simulation")

def run_simulation():
    import argparse

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="DD4hep Simulation Runner")
    parser.add_argument('--geometry', type=str, required=True, help='Path to the geometry file')
    parser.add_argument('--events', type=int, default=10, help='Number of events to simulate')
    parser.add_argument('--help', action='store_true', help='Show help message and exit')
    args, unknown = parser.parse_known_args()

    if args.help:
        print("Usage: python script.py --geometry <geometry_file> [--events <n>]")
        sys.exit(0)

    logger.info("Loading geometry file: %s", args.geometry)
    geometry = import_geometry(args.geometry)

    logger.info("Importing constants...")
    importConstants(geometry)

    logger.info("Setting up Geant4 simulation...")
    sim = DD4hepSimulation()
    sim.geometry = geometry

    logger.info("Printing detectors...")
    printDetectors(geometry)

    logger.info("Configuring UI...")
    ui = UI()
    setupUI(ui)

    logger.info("Setting up tracking field...")
    setupTrackingField(sim)

    logger.info("Setting up event actions...")
    sim.event_action = True

    logger.info("Setting up particle gun...")
    gun = Gun()
    sim.generator = gun

    logger.info("Setting up tracker...")
    setupTracker = tracker()
    sim.tracker = setupTracker

    logger.info("Building physics list...")
    physics = PhysicsList()
    setupPhysics(physics)
    sim.physics = physics

    logger.info("Executing Geant4 simulation...")
    execute(sim, events=args.events)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_simulation()
```
